$comment: Copy to config/ranks.json to customize. 'level' drives permission inheritance: a rank can run any command whose required level is <= the rank's level. 'inherits' is documentation only; numeric level is what's enforced.

vip.description: Donors / trusted players. Higher economy limits.

helper.description: Can answer tickets and view reports.

moderator.description: Chat moderation: mute, warn, slowmode, purge.

administrator.description: Full moderation plus broadcast and config viewing.

developer.description: Can reload modules and run diagnostics.
